title: John Hutchison's lab in Vancouver

tellings.quote: which I witnessed when I went over to his home. It was stuffed full of old oscilloscopes

plain: An inventor named John Hutchison is said to have run a cluttered home lab in Vancouver, Canada, from around 1990 to 2009, where he claimed strange effects such as objects lifting off the ground. The aviation journalist Nick Cook says he went there himself and found the home "stuffed full of old oscilloscopes", instruments that show electrical signals on a screen. Cook brings it up in a talk about anti-gravity, where he also mentions an engineer named Boyd Bushman.
